llm_response.reason: The site displays multiple scam characteristics: extreme promotion of discounts ('お得'), nationwide free shipping, generic and unverifiable company name, focus on psychological triggers (bargains, safety, easy returns), and lack of identifiable, traceable business contact information. There are no positive search reports or evidence of a legitimate track record. These fit numerous fake online shopping scam points such as too-good-to-be-true offers, ambiguous privacy/policy, generic corporate claims, and domain patterns associated with short-term scam operations.
